mapper.select: SELECT * FROM HDOC_USER_INFOR WHERE USERID = #{userId} AND PASSWORD = #{password}

SELECT DISTINCT ui.*, (SELECT MAX(ma.MARKET) FROM HDOC_MARKET_AUTH ma WHERE ma.USERID = ui.USERID) AS market FROM HDOC_USER_INFOR ui WHERE 1=1 AND ui.USERID LIKE CONCAT('%', #{userId}, '%') AND ui.USERNAME LIKE CONCAT('%', #{userName}, '%') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM HDOC_MARKET_AUTH ma WHERE ma.USERID = ui.USERID AND ma.MARKET = #{market}) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM HDOC_FUNCTION_AUTH fa WHERE fa.USERID = ui.USERID AND fa.FUNCTION = 'hdoc_user_rule') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM HDOC_FUNCTION_AUTH fa WHERE fa.USERID = ui.USERID AND fa.FUNCTION = 'hdoc_user_template')
